source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 6-24), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Computer Networks) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which kinds of devices can a computer network connect, and what can move between them?
(Computer network kin devices ko jod sakta hai aur un ke darmiyan kya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network computers, mobile phones, printers aur doosre digital devices ko jod sakta hai. Is ke zariye data, files aur resources (wasail) cables ya wireless signals se aik device se doosre tak jate hain.

book_ref.quote: A network allows data, files, and resources to move from one device to another.

blocks.prompt:
2 How does a computer network help in communication? Give two points.
(Computer network communication (raabte) mein kaise madad karta hai? Do nukte likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Is se maloomat jaldi aur aasani se share hoti hai.
2. Network ke zariye raabta waqt aur mehnat bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: Communication through networks saves time and effort.

blocks.prompt:
3 How do mobile phones and schools use computer networks?
(Mobile phones aur schools computer networks ko kaise istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile phones networks ko calls, messages aur apps ke liye istemal karte hain. Schools networks ko online classes aur learning systems ke liye istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Mobile phones use networks for calls, messages, and apps.

blocks.prompt:
4 Briefly describe how data travels from one device to another on a network.
(Mukhtasar batayein ke network par data aik device se doosre tak kaise jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Bhejne se pehle data chhote packets mein toda jata hai. Packets cables ya wireless signals se safar karte hain, networking devices unhein sahi manzil tak le jate hain aur receiving device unhein jod kar asal data bana deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A network works by sending data from one device to another.

blocks.prompt:
5 What does network architecture include? Write two benefits of a good architecture.
(Network architecture mein kya shamil hai? Achhi architecture ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Network architecture mein hardware, software aur communication rules (raabte ke usool) shamil hain. Achhi architecture (1) network ko efficient banati hai aur (2) aage network ko barhane (expansion) mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: A good architecture helps the network work efficiently.

blocks.prompt:
6 On what basis are computer networks classified? Why should we understand network types?
(Computer networks ki darja bandi kis bunyad par hoti hai? Network ki qismein samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Computer networks size aur coverage area (phailao) ki bunyad par taqseem hote hain. Qismein samajhne se sahi network chunna aasan hota hai, kyunke har qism alag maqsad ke liye hai.

book_ref.quote: Understanding network types helps in proper network selection.

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between LAN and WAN.
(LAN aur WAN mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qismon ka nukta ba nukta muqabla:

book_ref.quote: A Wide Area Network covers a large geographic area

rows: Chhote ilaqe (ghar, school, office) mein devices jodta hai.
Bada jughrafiyai ilaqa (shehar ya mulk) cover karta hai.
Data transfer ki raftar zyada hai.
Data transfer ki raftar LAN se kam hai.
Sasta aur sambhalne mein aasan.
Lagana aur chalana mehenga.
Ethernet aur Wi-Fi istemal hote hain.
Leased lines, satellites ya Internet istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
8 What is the Internet? Name two services that use it.
(Internet kya hai? Is ko istemal karne wali do services ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Internet aik aalmi network hai jo laakhon devices ko jodta hai aur duniya bhar mein maloomat share karne deta hai; yeh standard protocols istemal karta hai. Email aur websites (aur cloud storage) jaisi services Internet istemal karti hain.

book_ref.quote: The Internet is a global network connecting millions of devices.

blocks.prompt:
9 What are DSL and ISP?
(DSL aur ISP kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) telephone lines ke zariye Internet deti hai aur aik hi waqt mein call aur browsing ho sakti hai. ISP (Internet Service Provider) woh company hai jo users ko Internet deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Internet through telephone lines; allows calling and browsing at the same time.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why does a device need a Network Interface Card (NIC)?
(Device ko Network Interface Card (NIC) ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: NIC device ko network se jodta hai aur network se data bhejta aur leta hai. NIC ke baghair device network par baat nahin kar sakta. Yeh wired ya wireless ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Without a NIC, a device cannot communicate on a network.

blocks.prompt:
11 What is a MAC address?
(MAC address kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: MAC address woh unique (munfarid) address hai jo har Network Interface Card (NIC) ka hota hai. Isi NIC ke zariye device network par data bhejta aur leta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each NIC has a unique address called MAC address.

blocks.prompt:
12 What is a switch? Write one benefit of using it.
(Switch kya hai? Is ka aik faida likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Switch aik networking device hai jo devices ko jodta hai aur data sahi device tak bhejta hai. Switch network ki raftar aur karkardagi behtar karte hain aur jadeed networks mein aam hain.

book_ref.quote: Switches improve network speed and efficiency.

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between a switch and a router.
(Switch aur router mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono devices ka nukta ba nukta muqabla:

book_ref.quote: A router connects different networks together.

rows: Network ke andar devices jodta hai.
Mukhtalif networks ko aapas mein jodta hai.
Data sahi device tak bhejta hai.
IP addresses se data packets ko sahi manzil tak bhejta hai.
Network ki raftar aur karkardagi behtar karta hai.
Local network ko Internet se jodta hai aur security aur control behtar karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 Why does Internet access depend on a modem?
(Internet ki rasai modem par kyun munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Modem local network ko ISP se jodta hai. Yeh digital data ko bhejne ke qabil signals mein aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital shakal mein badalta hai, is liye is ke baghair network ISP tak nahin pohanchta.

book_ref.quote: Internet access depends on a modem.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is a wireless access point? Where is it used?
(Wireless access point kya hai? Yeh kahan istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wireless access point Wi-Fi deta hai aur wireless devices ko network se jodta hai; yeh wireless coverage barhata hai. Access points badi imaraton aur campuses mein lagaye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: A wireless access point provides Wi-Fi connectivity.

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between physical topology and logical topology.
(Physical topology aur logical topology mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qismon ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Physical topology shows actual connections.

rows: Asal connections dikhati hai.
Dikhati hai ke network mein data kaise behta hai.
Batati hai ke devices aur cables kaise lage hain.
Batati hai ke data kis raste chalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 Write two advantages and two disadvantages of bus topology.
(Bus topology ke do fawaid aur do nuqsanat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fawaid: saada aur sasti hai; kam cable lagti hai.
Nuqsanat: main cable kharab ho to poora network ruk sakta hai; bade networks ke liye achhi nahin.

book_ref.quote: It is simple and low in cost.

blocks.prompt:
18 In a star topology, what happens if (i) one device fails, (ii) the central hub fails?
(Star topology mein kya hota hai agar (i) aik device kharab ho, (ii) central hub kharab ho?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Aik device kharab ho to baqi par asar nahin hota, kyunke har device ka centre se apna link hai.
(ii) Central hub kharab ho to poora network ruk jata hai, kyunke sara data isi se guzarta hai.

book_ref.quote: Failure of one device does not affect others.

blocks.prompt:
19 How does data travel in a ring topology? Why is it risky?
(Ring topology mein data kaise chalta hai? Yeh khatarnak kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Devices daire mein jude hote hain; data aik simt mein ghoomta hai aur har device data le kar aage bhejta hai. Is liye aik device kharab ho to poora network mutasir ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each device receives data and passes it along.

blocks.prompt:
20 Why is mesh topology reliable but expensive?
(Mesh topology bharosemand magar mehengi kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har device kai devices se juda hota hai, is liye kai raste hote hain; aik link toote to data doosra rasta le leta hai (bharosemand). Magar itne connections ke liye bohat cables chahiye, is liye mehengi aur pecheeda hai.

book_ref.quote: This increases reliability and fault tolerance.

blocks.prompt:
21 Define tree topology. Where is it commonly used?
(Tree topology ki definition likhein. Yeh aam tor par kahan istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tree topology mein devices darakht jaisi darja ba darja (hierarchical) shakal mein hote hain: kai star networks aik central backbone se jude hote hain aur data root se branches tak jata hai. Yeh bade idaron mein aam hai.

book_ref.quote: In tree topology, devices are arranged in a hierarchical structure like a tree

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between star topology and ring topology (Table 1.1).
(Star topology aur ring topology mein farq likhein (Table 1.1).)
blocks.explanation: Table 1.1 aur topologies ki tafseel se muqabla:

book_ref.quote: • Easy to install and manage • Failure of one device does not affect others • Easy to detect faults

rows: Tamam devices central hub ya switch se jude hote hain.
Devices daire mein jude hote hain.
Aik device ki kharabi baqi par asar nahin dalti.
Aik device ki kharabi poore network ko mutasir karti hai.
Central device kharab ho to poora network ruk jata hai.
Data aik simt mein chalta hai; takrao nahin hota.
Lagana, sambhalna aur kharabi dhoondna aasan.
Devices lagana ya hatana mushkil.
Aaj kal zyada istemal hoti hai.
Ab kam istemal hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 Give two advantages of mesh topology and two of tree topology from Table 1.1.
(Table 1.1 se mesh topology ke do aur tree topology ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mesh: bohat bharosemand aur fault-tolerant; data ke kai raste (aur zyada security).
Tree: barhana aasan; bade networks ke liye munasib (aur darja ba darja intezam).

book_ref.quote: • Very expensive • Complex installation • Requires large number of cables

blocks.prompt:
24 What are network models? Give two of their benefits.
(Network models kya hain? In ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Network models batate hain ke data aik device se doosre tak munazzam tareeqe se kaise jata hai; yeh communication ko layers mein taqseem karte hain. Yeh networks samajhna aur sambhalna aasan aur troubleshooting mein madad karte hain; inhein standards ke tor par istemal kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Network models explain how data moves from one device to another in an organized way.

blocks.prompt:
25 What are network layers? Why is a layered structure useful?
(Network layers kya hain? Layered dhancha kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network layers communication ke amal ko chhote hisson mein baant deti hain, har aik ki apni zimmedari hai; data qadam ba qadam in se guzarta hai. Is se design saada aur munazzam rehta hai aur aik layer ki tabdeeli doosri par asar nahin dalti.

book_ref.quote: Network layers divide the communication process into smaller parts.

blocks.prompt:
26 Name the seven layers of the OSI model in order, from the Application layer down.
(OSI model ki saat layers ke naam tarteeb se likhein, Application layer se neeche tak.)
blocks.explanation: Application, Presentation, Session, Transport, Network, Data Link, Physical. Sender ki taraf data Application layer se neeche Physical layer tak jata hai (Figure 1.13).

book_ref.quote: The OSI model has seven layers.

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between the Physical layer and the Data Link layer.
(Physical layer aur Data Link layer mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: OSI ki do sab se neeche wali layers ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Sends raw data as electrical, optical, or radio signals over the medium.

rows: Raw data ko electrical, optical ya radio signals ki shakal mein bhejti hai.
Seedhe jude nodes ke darmiyan be-ghalti data transfer yaqeeni banati hai.
Hardware ki tafseel tay karti hai: cables, connectors, voltage levels, transmission rates.
Framing aur error detection/correction karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
28 Write the functions of the Transport layer.
(Transport layer ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Transport layer devices ke darmiyan data ki bharosemand aur tarteeb wali delivery deti hai. Yeh error recovery, flow control aur data ko chhote hisson mein todne (segmentation) ka kaam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Provides reliable and ordered delivery of data between devices.

blocks.prompt:
29 What does the Session layer do?
(Session layer kya karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Session layer applications ke darmiyan communication sessions shuru, qaim aur khatam karti hai. Rukawat ki surat mein checkpoints aur recovery sambhalti hai.

book_ref.quote: It manages session checkpoints and recovery in case of interruptions.

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the role of the Presentation layer?
(Presentation layer ka kirdar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Presentation layer data ko aise format mein badalti hai jo application layer samajh sake. Yeh encryption, compression aur format conversion karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Translates data into a format understandable by the application layer.

blocks.prompt:
31 How is work divided among the lower, middle and upper layers of the OSI model?
(OSI model ki lower, middle aur upper layers mein kaam kaise taqseem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lower layers physical data transfer karti hain; middle layers routing aur delivery sambhalti hain; upper layers user applications ko support karti hain. Har layer alag kaam karti hai aur sab mil kar durust raabta yaqeeni banati hain.

book_ref.quote: Lower layers handle physical data transfer.

blocks.prompt:
32 What does a network protocol control? Give two examples of protocols.
(Network protocol kin cheezon ko control karta hai? Protocols ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Protocol tay karta hai ke data kis format mein aur kaise bheja jaye, aur error handling aur data delivery control karta hai, taake devices hamwar tareeqe se data badal sakein. Misalein: TCP/IP aur HTTP.

book_ref.quote: It defines how data is formatted and transmitted.

blocks.prompt:
33 Expand TCP/IP. What is the role of TCP and of IP?
(TCP/IP ka poora naam likhein. TCP aur IP ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: TCP/IP ka matlab Transmission Control Protocol aur Internet Protocol hai. TCP data ki bharosemand delivery yaqeeni banata hai; IP data ki addressing aur routing karta hai.

book_ref.quote: TCP/IP stands for Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol.

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between HTTP and HTTPS.
(HTTP aur HTTPS mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono web protocols ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: HTTP does not encrypt data; secure websites use HTTPS instead.

rows: Hypertext Transfer Protocol: browser aur server ke darmiyan web pages bhejta hai.
HTTP ka mehfooz (secure) version.
Data encrypt nahin karta.
Browser aur server ke darmiyan data ko encryption se bachata hai.
Hamla awar data beech mein pakad sakte hain.
SSL/TLS encryption passwords aur payment data ko aasani se chori hone se bachati hai.

blocks.prompt:
35 What is FTP? Write two of its uses or features.
(FTP kya hai? Is ke do istemal ya khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) files upload aur download karne ke liye hai aur computers ke darmiyan file sharing karne deta hai. Web developers ise aam istemal karte hain aur yeh badi files bhi bhej sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: FTP allows file sharing between computers.

blocks.prompt:
36 Why must every network device have an IP address?
(Har network device ka IP address hona kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: IP address aik unique number hai jo network par device ki pehchan karata hai. Data apni manzil IP address se dhoondta hai, is liye is ke baghair raabta mumkin nahin.

book_ref.quote: Data uses IP addresses to find its destination.

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between IPv4 and IPv6.
(IPv4 aur IPv6 mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: IP addressing ke dono versions ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: IPv4 is an older version of IP addressing.

rows: IP addressing ka purana version.
Naya version.
32-bit numeric addresses.
128-bit addresses.
4 numbers (0-255) dots se alag, jaise 192.168.1.10.
4 hexadecimal digits ke 8 groups, colons se alag.
Addresses mehdood (taqreeban 4.29 billion).
Zyada address space (taqreeban 3.4 x 10^38); jadeed Internet ki zaroorat poori karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
38 In the IPv4 address 192.168.1.10, identify the network part and the host part.
(IPv4 address 192.168.1.10 mein network part aur host part pehchanein.)
blocks.explanation:
Network part: 192.168.1 - local network ki pehchan (gali ki tarah).
Host part: 10 - us network par khaas device ki pehchan (ghar number ki tarah).

book_ref.quote: Identifies your local network, like

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is an IPv4 address 32 bits long?
(IPv4 address 32 bits ka kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: IPv4 address mein 4 numbers hote hain, har aik 0-255, aur har number 1 byte = 8 bits hai. Is liye kul 4 x 8 = 32 bits.

book_ref.quote: Each number = 1 Byte = 8 bits

blocks.prompt:
40 Name the three parts of the IPv6 address 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334.
(IPv6 address 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334 ke teen hisson ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Global routing prefix: 2001:0db8:85a3 (ISP/ilaqa).
Subnet ID: 0000 (ISP ke andar local network).
Interface ID: 0000:8a2e:0370:7334 (khaas device).

book_ref.quote: Your local network inside the ISP, like

blocks.prompt:
41 What is subnetting? Write two of its benefits.
(Subnetting kya hai? Is ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Subnetting network ko chhote hisson mein taqseem karti hai; har hissa subnet kehlata hai. Is se network traffic kam aur performance behtar hoti hai (security bhi barhti hai).

book_ref.quote: Subnetting divides a network into smaller parts.

blocks.prompt:
42 What is NAT? How does it improve security?
(NAT kya hai? Yeh security kaise behtar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: NAT (Network Address Translation), jo router karta hai, bohat se devices ko aik public IP address share karne deta hai. Yeh devices ke private IP addresses chhupata hai, is se network security behtar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It hides private IP addresses.

blocks.prompt:
43 What is a home network? Why is proper configuration needed?
(Home network kya hai? Durust configuration kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Home network ghar ke devices, jaise computers, mobile phones aur printers, ko jodta hai taake woh baat karein aur aik hi internet connection share karein. Durust configuration network ki raftar aur hifazat behtar karti hai.

book_ref.quote: A home network is used to connect different devices in a house.

blocks.prompt:
44 What are the roles of the router and the modem in a home network?
(Home network mein router aur modem ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Router ghar ke network ke tamam devices ko jodta hai. Modem ghar ke network ko Internet Service Provider se jodta hai.

book_ref.quote: A router connects all devices in the network.

blocks.prompt:
45 Differentiate between wired and wireless network connections.
(Wired aur wireless network connections mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qism ke connections ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: A wireless network connects devices without using cables.

rows: Cables (aam tor par Ethernet) istemal hoti hain.
Bina cables, radio signals (Wi-Fi) se devices jodta hai.
Tez raftar aur mustahkam performance.
Kuch suraton mein wired se sust ho sakta hai.
Wireless se zyada mehfooz.
Lagana aur istemal karna aasan.
Cables ki wajah se devices aazadi se hil nahin sakte.
Range ke andar devices aazadi se hil sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
46 Why is Wi-Fi security important? Give two reasons.
(Wi-Fi security kyun zaroori hai? Do wajahen likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh network ko ghair mutalliqa logon se bachati hai; security ke baghair koi bhi internet chala sakta hai aur hackers zaati maloomat chura sakte hain.
2. Data mehfooz aur raaz mein rehta hai aur internet sust nahin hota.

book_ref.quote: Wi-Fi security protects the network from unauthorized access.

blocks.prompt:
47 What is the router web interface? How is it opened?
(Router web interface kya hai? Yeh kaise khulta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh router ki settings, jaise Wi-Fi ka naam, password aur security settings, sambhalne ke liye hai. Ise web browser mein router ka IP address likh kar aur username aur password se login kar ke khola jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The router web interface is used to manage router settings.

blocks.prompt:
48 What is Wi-Fi encryption? Which protocols should be chosen?
(Wi-Fi encryption kya hai? Kaun se protocols chunne chahiyein?)
blocks.explanation: Wi-Fi encryption network par bheje gaye data ko mehfooz shakal mein badal kar bachati hai. WPA2 aur WPA3 aam protocols hain; WEP jaise purane mehfooz nahin, is liye naya tareeqa chunna chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Users should always select the latest encryption method.

blocks.prompt:
49 What is a default gateway?
(Default gateway kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Default gateway local network ko doosre networks se jodta hai; yeh aam tor par router hota hai. Bahar ke networks ke liye data isi se guzarta hai aur yeh data ko sahi network tak bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: Data meant for outside networks goes through the gateway.

blocks.prompt:
50 What is a guest network? Write two of its benefits.
(Guest network kya hai? Is ke do fawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Guest network mehmanon ko internet istemal karne deta hai; yeh main ghar ke network se alag hota hai. Fawaid: mehman zaati devices tak nahin pohanchte (zyada hifazat aur privacy), aur internet ka istemal control hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A guest network allows visitors to use the internet.

blocks.prompt:
51 What are network diagnostic tools? How are their commands entered?
(Network diagnostic tools kya hain? In ki commands kaise di jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Network diagnostic tools network ke masail dhoondne ke liye hain; yeh connections check karte aur dikhate hain ke devices sahi baat kar rahe hain ya nahin. In ki commands command prompt ya terminal mein likhi jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Network diagnostic tools are used to find network problems.

blocks.prompt:
52 What is network troubleshooting? What does it check?
(Network troubleshooting kya hai? Yeh kya check karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network troubleshooting network ke masail, jaise connection aur speed ki kharabi, dhoond kar theek karna hai. Yeh cables, devices aur settings check karti hai aur downtime aur errors kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Network troubleshooting is done to find and fix network issues.

blocks.prompt:
53 What is the ping command? Write the command to test the connection to google.com.
(Ping command kya hai? google.com se connection test karne ki command likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ping command network connectivity test karti hai: yeh device ko chhote data packets bhejti hai aur response time napti hai.
C:\> ping google.com

book_ref.quote: The ping command is used to test network connectivity.

blocks.prompt:
54 From the reply line 'Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118', write the IP address of the destination, the packet size and the response time.
(Reply line 'Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118' se destination ka IP address, packet ka size aur response time likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Destination ka IP address: 142.250.190.14
Packet size: 32 bytes
Response time: 25 ms

book_ref.quote: Ping sends small data packets to another device

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between the ipconfig and ifconfig commands.
(ipconfig aur ifconfig commands mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono commands ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Ipconfig is used in Windows operating system.

rows: Windows operating system mein istemal hoti hai.
Linux aur macOS mein istemal hoti hai.
IP address aur subnet mask jaisi network settings dikhati hai.
Isi qism ki network settings dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between Telnet and SSH.
(Telnet aur SSH mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Remote access ke dono tareeqon ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Telnet is used for remote device access.

rows: Door se device tak rasai (remote access) ke liye.
Remote access ka mehfooz tareeqa.
Data bina encryption bhejta hai.
Hifazat ke liye data encrypt karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
57 What is network performance? What happens when it is poor?
(Network performance kya hai? Kharab performance ka kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network performance ka matlab hai network kitna achha kaam karta hai; yeh data transfer ki raftar aur miyar dikhati hai. Kharab performance se internet sust aur der hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Network performance means how well a network works.

blocks.prompt:
58 Define network bandwidth and give its usual unit.
(Network bandwidth ki definition aur is ki aam unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Network bandwidth diye gaye waqt mein bheja gaya data hai; yeh dikhati hai ke network kitna data utha sakta hai. Yeh aam tor par Mbps mein napi jati hai.
